item.title: World Cup 2026 latest: buildup to France v England third-place playoff and Spain v Argentina final
item.description:
A Final to Remember: The 2026 World Cup Showdown

As the sun sets on the 2026 World Cup, the stage is set for a thrilling final weekend. Tomorrow, Spain and Argentina will face off in New York/New Jersey, with the world watching as these two football giants clash in a battle for supremacy. But before the main event, the third-place playoff between France and England will take center stage in Miami, offering a tantalizing glimpse into the competitive spirit that has defined this tournament.

item.title: World Cup final ref confirmed: Who is the Spain vs Argentina official?
item.description:
World Cup Showdown: Slovenian Referee Ready for Spain vs Argentina Final

The stage is set for a thrilling conclusion to the World Cup, with Spain and Argentina set to clash in the final at New York New Jersey Stadium on Sunday. At the centre of the action will be Slovenian referee Slavko Vincic, who has been confirmed to lead the way in his second World Cup and fourth major summer tournament. Vincic’s experience in big matches is unparalleled, having officiated in the Europa League final in 2022 and the Champions League final between Real Madrid and Borussia Dortmund in 2024.
